text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During our outing,
we stopped by a traditional folk-house café for a break—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Huh, how charming! A blend of the old and the new... It's just like a remade masterpiece!"
choice_data_list: The furnishings are lovely too, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The hanging scrolls, the vase... and even that beckoning cat!
Um, can I take pictures for reference!?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Go right ahead, I don't mind at all.
Truth be told, when I bought this old house,
this came out of the storehouse in the back.
choice_data_list: Do you have all sorts of other goods like this, too?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
That's right. There are so many I haven't even been able to put them all up...
Would you like to take a look if you have time?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, are you sure!?
I'd love to!"

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
This is the storehouse. Please watch your step.
We haven't quite finished organizing everything yet, you see.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa... Oh, these are the old tools from the textbook!
It's kind of magnificent!
I bet there are real historical treasures here!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true enough. There might even
be some things here better off donated
to a museum.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, ow!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngh, something just... popped into my head—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...This... is...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Was something like that...
really there when I looked before?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...A mysterious magatama stored away in the storehouse.
Today, it was discovered completely by chance..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: T-This is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The story... is in motion!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's a classic manga trope! Like a spirit popping out of a treasure stored in the storehouse! Or meeting a yokai that was sealed away in a storehouse!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When the protagonist encounters what was sleeping inside the storehouse――that's where the story begins!
choice_data_list: It's definitely a common trope, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That has to be it!
A magatama that even the Owner has never seen before fell right out of the sky onto my head, you know!?"

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, that's true.
...If you'd like, you can have that one.
choice_data_list: No way, what if it's something really valuable...?!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, seeing everyone having so much fun made me want to join in on the amusement too.
Please take this as a souvenir, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaah... thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ehe, ehehe...♪
choice_data_list: You're in a good mood, huh.
You seem to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell? Well, I mean...
isn't it just so much fun?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Things sealed away since antiquity, close encounters of the third kind...
What if, through some twist of fate, it actually happened!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"What should I say first when we meet~?
A dramatic encounter would be nice. I mean, this is special!
Everything rides on the opening line~...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, isn't it pretty common for someone to suddenly reply when you're talking to yourself?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah-ah, I ended up getting an amazing magatama~
Somehow, it feels really incredible... I think~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, no! ...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Plop)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!?
The magatama is in the pond!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but, but!
What if it's the pattern where she falls into water by chance and revives...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“...It's not here!
I'm so sorry, Trainer!
Please help me look for it!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Kiseki kept trying out idea after idea as they came to mind...—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mmm, they're not waking up easily, are they?
choice_data_list: If there's nothing there, that means...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait! It's too early to give up!
Things like this, late at night when everyone is asleep...
Sometimes things move behind the scenes...!"

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, thank goodness you're here!
Excuse me, but regarding that magatama from earlier,
there's something I need to tell you...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Owner-san!
Wait, did you find something out!?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... It turns out my wife
made that by hand, apparently...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh, handmade?! That's amazing,
I had no idea you could make something so pretty~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ……Hm? Handmade……?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: Yes. Apparently they made it with leftover materials to test a new rasp. They shoved it in the storehouse and left it there until now...
choice_data_list: So... it just fell down by chance?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: Um, my wife said it was totally fine to give it to you, so if you'd like... It's amateur work, so I'm a bit embarrassed, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I, seeee......!
...Thank you very much......!"
choice_data_list: Well, don't let it get you down!
Who cares if there's nothing, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! That's right. It definitely must be fate
that brought it into my hands.
I'll take good care of it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Still, are you really sure nothing's wrong?
Like, you didn't get possessed by a wandering soul from the storehouse or anything?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kiseki still didn't seem ready to give up.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......No, but still.
There's still the night!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There might just
be something there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kiseki still didn't seem ready to give up.
